description: This source file defines a custom implementation of a singly linked list data structure, including methods for adding, removing, obtaining size, and retrieving elements by index.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A custom singly linked list implementation with basic operations such as add, remove, size, and get.

classes.name: LinkedList.Node
classes.description: A private inner class representing a node in the linked list, holding data and reference to the next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Helper method to unlink (remove) a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Static helper method to find the tail node of the list starting from the given head.
